study type: quasi-experimental study with prospective participant recruitment and retrospective analysis
exposure: social support integrated into group prenatal care
cohort: The study included 200 postpartum Black and Hispanic women, with an average age of 26.8 years, who received either group prenatal care or traditional individualized prenatal care.
finding: No significant differences were observed between group prenatal care and traditional individualized care models in terms of total postpartum depression scores or score ranges at six weeks postpartum.
